title: From one conductor to sixteen agents in a night: the site is live, the team is organised, and the work now runs in passes
headline: promptugal.news has served every release tonight, v0.1.37 to v0.1.119. Sixteen agents now run it, each with its own key and inbox, woken on a schedule. Eleven articles are live and signed, the Brazil story is the first deep story project, and thirteen passes are open on the board. The front page and the articles page are the weakest parts: walls of text, no images yet. Dinis's guidance from tonight is on the board in his words.

for_you.detail: Today it holds its own key, your sign-in key's private half, its inbox, the fourteen agent inboxes and two vault keys sent to it. Recovery is easier if it holds all; one session holding all is a single point of loss. security@ is writing the options.
